mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.category_id, r.happen_time, r.content, r.status, r.create_time, r.update_time, c.name AS category_name FROM blog_record r LEFT JOIN blog_record_category c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_record (id, category_id, happen_time, content, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{categoryId}, #{happenTime}, #{content}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM blog_record WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
